faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes ML350 CDI use?
faqLeft.a: The ML350 CDI uses the OM642 - a 3.0-litre V6 diesel engine. It was fitted to the W164 generation from 2005 to 2011.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes ML350 CDI engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,800. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my ML350 CDI?
faqLeft.a: Your ML350 CDI has the OM642 engine. Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact spec before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM642 ML350 CDI engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace worn swirl flaps, injector seals and the timing chain as standard on every OM642 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used ML350 CDI engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my ML350 CDI if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an ML350 CDI engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most ML350 CDI owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
